tools.name: wordpress_get_content
tools.description: Retrieve the full readable text and metadata of a published WordPress item by its numeric ID.

tools.name: wordpress_get_site_info
tools.description: Get public information about this WordPress website, including its name, description, URL, language, timezone, and searchable content types.

tools.name: wordpress_get_visible_page
tools.description: Get a concise, readable representation of the WordPress page currently visible in this browser tab.

tools.name: wordpress_list_content
tools.description: List recently modified public WordPress content. Optionally filter by an enabled post type.

type.description: Optional WordPress post type such as post or page.

tools.name: wordpress_navigate
tools.description: Navigate the current browser tab to a URL on this same WordPress website. External domains are rejected.

url.description: Absolute same-site URL or a root-relative path.

tools.name: wordpress_search_content
tools.description: Search published WordPress pages, posts, and other enabled public content types on this website.

query.description: Words or phrase to search for.
